description.en: PhantomBench evaluates language models' ability to abstain from answering about non-existent entities. It comprises over 60,000 non-existent terms derived from real concepts across domains, and provides a pipeline for generating further instances.

evidence.snippet: We introduce PhantomBench, the first large-scale benchmark of its kind, comprising more than 60K non-existent terms and entities derived from real concepts across diverse domains.

claire_radar.motivation: Hallucinations, where language models (LMs) generate factually ungrounded responses, pose serious risks, as users tend to blindly rely on them.
